last.verdict: EVgo cut its 2026 outlook a second time, but charging growth is strong, and a $2.00-a-share buyout offer from majority owner LS Power now frames the stock.

takeaways.label: Second guidance cut
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook fell to $375-400M from $400-430M, and the expected adjusted EBITDA loss widened to $15-30M from $5-25M, after August's cut.

takeaways.label: Buyout offer
takeaways.text: LS Power, the controlling shareholder, proposed buying the rest of EVgo for $2.00 per share in cash, a 59% premium to the Oct. 30 close. The board's special committee has made no decision.

takeaways.label: Charging up, total flat
takeaways.text: Charging revenue rose 29% to $72M, but total revenue slipped 1% to $91.4M because partner-built (eXtend) revenue fell 49%. Per-stall usage dipped to 283 kWh a day from 295.

takeaways.label: Cash drain rising
takeaways.text: Net loss widened to $49.2M from $28.4M. Cash fell to $98.7M from $151M at year-end, while debt rose to about $316M from about $207M.

history.verdict: Investors sold EVgo after the company cut its full-year outlook and cash burn rose.

reasons.label: Lower 2026 outlook
reasons.text: Revenue guidance cut to $400-430M from $410-470M; below analysts' roughly $433M.

reasons.label: Bigger expected losses
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted EBITDA now a $5-25M loss, versus a range reaching up to +$20M before.

reasons.label: Cash and slower ramp
reasons.text: Operating cash burn widened and new stalls ramped slower than hoped, despite Tesla deal.
